name: Sample Risky Token
summary: This token is risky. Its creator can mint new tokens at any time and can freeze your sale. On top of that, seventy-four percent of the supply sits in just ten wallets, and the website makes guaranteed-return promises.

checks.label: Can new tokens be minted?
checks.detail: Yes. Mint authority is still open; the creator can mint as many tokens as they like.

checks.label: Can your sale be frozen?
checks.detail: Yes. Freeze authority is open; if your wallet is frozen you cannot sell.

checks.label: Who holds the supply?
checks.detail: The top 10 wallets hold 74% of the supply.

checks.label: Is there enough liquidity?
checks.detail: The pool holds about $18,000 in liquidity and it is not locked.

checks.label: Is the website trustworthy?
checks.detail: The site contains unrealistic promises such as 'guaranteed' and '100x'.

siteFlags.text: "24 hours only: 500% bonus for early buyers"
The team and roadmap page is almost identical to another project's.
